headline: Argentina Postpones Belgrano Cargas Privatization Bidding and Relaxes Terms
summary: The Argentine government postponed the bidding deadline for the privatization of Belgrano Cargas to December 21 and relaxed financial, technical, and RIGI requirements following requests from interested companies.
why: Privatization processes of major freight rail networks are critical milestones in Argentina's structural reform and infrastructure investment agenda.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Postponement of national infrastructure privatization impacts the country's economic reform timeline.
